ccb-edema-loop-diuretic:med-amlodipine+m.title: Possible prescribing cascade: Amlodipine → ankle swelling → Furosemide (Lasix)
ccb-edema-loop-diuretic:med-amlodipine+m.plain: Furosemide (Lasix) was started on Jul 14, 45 days after Amlodipine, for “ankle swelling”. Ankle swelling (peripheral edema) is a known possible effect of amlodipine-type medicines; a new medicine started for an effect like this is called a prescribing cascade.
ccb-edema-loop-diuretic:med-amlodipine+m.clinician: Amlodipine started May 30; Furosemide (Lasix) started Jul 14 (+45 days) for “ankle swelling”. Dihydropyridine CCB edema is driven by arteriolar vasodilation and responds poorly to diuretics; new loop diuretic dispensing after CCB initiation is a documented cascade (Savage 2020).
